subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Should user-visible context-overflow diagnostics include session/channel identity and token/model numbers, and what redaction policy should govern those fields?
rationale: Current code already computes or logs many requested facts, but exposing them in channel-visible messages can leak raw session keys or channel identifiers unless maintainers choose the product and privacy boundary first.

options.title: Use redacted shared diagnostics
options.body: Implement a shared formatter that shows provider/model, safe context budget/count/overage fields, and a redacted display label rather than raw internal identifiers.

options.title: Keep details in logs only
options.body: Leave channel-visible overflow copy generic and document that operators should use logs/session diagnostics for detailed token and model facts.

options.title: Defer to broader context visibility work
options.body: Keep this issue open but make a broader context-status design own warning thresholds, post-compaction notices, and overflow diagnostics together.

recommendation.title: Use redacted shared diagnostics
recommendation.body: Implement a shared formatter that shows provider/model, safe context budget/count/overage fields, and a redacted display label rather than raw internal identifiers.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has recent history in the runner/auto-reply overflow paths and already framed the prior review around the needed cross-path diagnostic design.
